Success: A complete public customer dataset containing 7,043 records and 21 original variables was used.
The final cleaned dataset contains no missing values and no duplicate rows.
TotalCharges was converted from text to numeric, and the 11 blank records were investigated before being represented as zero.
EDA combined descriptive statistics, visualizations, correlation analysis, chi-square association tests, and Mann-Whitney tests.
Service, security/support, streaming, and customer-lifecycle features were created.
K-Means clustering was evaluated across K=2 to K=10 using multiple cluster-quality metrics.
A baseline classifier, Logistic Regression, and Random Forest were compared.
Five-fold stratified cross-validation and hyperparameter tuning were performed.
False positives and false negatives were investigated by customer characteristics and customer segments.
Logistic Regression coefficients and Random Forest feature importance were examined.
